about: More call time a member asks for from the seat and the floor approves (decision 0320). The member picks 30 minutes, 1 hour or 2 hours; the floor's approval adds exactly that to the seat's call time. Only a seat with call time (more than nought minutes) can have more, and a call time is at most a day, 1,440 minutes, in all: a request that would pass it is refused, never cut down. Any other length is refused. Approving after the call time completed adds the time the same way; the completion recorded stands.

cases.description: An hour added to a three-hour call time makes four.
Half an hour added to three hours.
Two hours added to five hours.
At the cap: an hour onto 23 hours makes exactly a day.
At the cap: two hours onto 22 hours makes exactly a day.
Past the cap by a minute: half an hour onto 1,411 minutes is refused, not cut to a day.
Past the cap: an hour onto 1,400 minutes is refused.
Zero: a seat with no call time has none to add to.
Not a choice: 45 minutes is refused.
Not a choice: nothing added is refused.
Not a choice: a negative length is refused, never taken off.
